title: A malicious actor who lures an authenticated user to a malicious page could exploit a Cross-Site Request Forgery…
description: CVE-2026-116838 is a Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) vulnerability affecting airMAX M devices. An attacker can lure an authenticated user to a malicious page to exploit this flaw and execute command injection on the device. The vulnerability has a high severity score of 8.8, indicating significant potential impact on confidentiality, integrity, and availability.
